environment.description: ECS Fargate service in an isolated VPC (no IGW, no NAT). SQS access is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs VPC Interface Endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy that restricts sqs:SendMessage to only the IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/order-service-producer-role. The endpoint has private DNS enabled. Additionally, the SQS queue resource policy has a condition key aws:sourceVpce restricting SendMessage to vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The RDS instance has IAM database authentication enabled with a restrictive permission boundary on the task role.

config.network: isolated VPC, no IGW, no NAT gateway, no VPC peering except to shared-services VPC for monitoring
config.rds_iam_auth: enabled, permission boundary restricts to SELECT/INSERT on orders table only
config.producer_service: internal order-api running in same VPC, validates input schema with JSON Schema before sending to SQS
